info.title: gadk-console JSON API
info.description: The read-only JSON API of gadk-console: the data of its usage, sessions, users, prompt-version, trace-score and review views, from the BigQuery trace source. Every successful data response is the envelope {data, truncated, next}; every error is {error: {kind, message, hint}}. Every /api path answers a method other than GET, HEAD or OPTIONS with the 405 response MethodNotAllowed (Allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS); HEAD follows GET, and OPTIONS answers 204 for CORS preflights.

get.summary: Calls and tokens per model, agent and prompt version
get.description: The usage breakdown over the range, as on /usage, each cell priced. truncated: the query hit its row cap.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: Calls and tokens per time bucket
get.description: The window start, the bucket width and one priced cell per bucket, model, agent and prompt version. truncated: the query hit its row cap.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: The traces with the most tokens
get.description: The 20 traces with the most tokens over the range, each with its calls per model, priced. truncated is always false.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.description: At most 100 sessions, as on /sessions, each priced. next is the next page when there are more sessions. truncated: the query hit its row cap. 400 for a too-long user or agent or an invalid cursor.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: A session's row and its turns
get.description: The session's row and its first 200 turns, oldest first, each priced, as on /sessions/{id}. truncated: the session has more than 200 turns. 400 for an invalid session id.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.description: At most 100 users, as on /users, each priced. truncated: the query hit its row cap or there are more than 100 users. 400 for a too-long agent.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: Production metrics and feedback per prompt version
get.description: Per-version calls, mean tokens and latency with their cost, the calls per version and model with theirs, and the scores per version, as on /prompts/{name}. The prompt store is not read: an unknown name has empty rows. truncated: the metrics or the feedback were truncated.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: The scores of a trace and its invocations
get.description: The trace's scores and its invocations', newest first, as in the trace page's Scores section. truncated: the query hit its row cap.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.summary: The pending traces of a review queue
get.description: The queue's pending traces, newest first, at most 100, as on /review. A queue needs a score or a rubric, not both. truncated: the queue has more than 100 traces.

200.description: The envelope with the route's data.

get.description: Answers with or without the BigQuery source. info.version is the console's version.

UsageRange.name: range
UsageRange.description: The window ending now: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d, 30d. Unknown or missing is 24h.

SessionsRange.name: range
SessionsRange.description: The window ending now: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d. Unknown or missing is 24h.

WeekRange.name: range
WeekRange.description: The window ending now: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d. Unknown or missing is 7d.

ReviewRange.name: range
ReviewRange.description: The window ending now: 1h, 6h, 24h, 7d; missing is 7d. Anything else is a 400.

User.name: user
User.description: Only this user's sessions (at most 128 bytes, trimmed; longer is a 400).

Agent.name: agent
Agent.description: Only this root agent's rows (at most 128 bytes, trimmed; longer is a 400).

After.name: after
After.description: The cursor: the last activity of the previous page's last session. Comes with after_id; next carries both.

AfterId.name: after_id
AfterId.description: The cursor: the previous page's last session id. Comes with after.

Score.name: score
Score.description: The queue's score name (1-100 bytes, trimmed): traces without a console score of that name. One of score or rubric is required.

Rubric.name: rubric
Rubric.description: Instead of score: the name of a rubric loaded with --rubrics. One of score or rubric is required.

Prompt.name: prompt
Prompt.description: Only traces whose LLM requests used this prompt.

Version.name: version
Version.description: Only traces that used this version of prompt; needs prompt.

Flagged.name: flagged
Flagged.description: 1: only traces with an app thumbs-down. Any other value is ignored.

SessionId.name: id
SessionId.description: The session id, percent-encoded. An id that is too long or has control characters is a 400.

TraceId.name: id
TraceId.description: The trace id: 32 hexadecimal digits. Any other id is the not_found 404.

BadRequest.description: bad_request: a bad parameter, with the page's text, or a request the router cannot read (invalid request: …).

NeedsBigQuery.description: needs_bigquery: the console is not using the BigQuery source; the message is the page's note. This comes before any other check.

SessionNotFound.description: needs_bigquery: the console is not using the BigQuery source (checked first); or not_found: the session has no activity in the range (no activity for session <id> in the last <range>).

TraceNotFound.description: needs_bigquery: the console is not using the BigQuery source (checked first); or not_found: an unknown or invalid trace id (trace not found).

QueryFailed.description: A failed query: kind is the source's (bigquery, transport, …), and message and hint are the error banner's text and hint.

MethodNotAllowed.description: method_not_allowed: the API is read-only. Every /api path answers it for a method other than GET, HEAD or OPTIONS.

error.description: The error: its kind, message and hint.

ApiErrorBody.description: The error: its kind, message and hint.

kind.description: bad_request, needs_bigquery, not_found, method_not_allowed, or for a 502 the source's kind (bigquery, transport, …).

message.description: What went wrong: the page's text or the error banner's.

hint.description: How to fix it, from the error banner; null when there is none.

Cost.description: The cost fields of a priced row.

cost_usd.description: The sum of the priced calls in USD, unrounded; null when no call had a price (always, without --prices).

cost_partial.description: Some calls had a price and some did not.

input.description: Input tokens (prompt plus tool-use prompt), cached ones included.

ModelCalls.description: The calls of one model and their tokens.

Cell.description: The calls of one model by one agent with one prompt version (name@version, or null).

agent.description: The agent (empty when the rows have none).

prompt.description: The prompt version as name@version; null for calls without a prompt.

PricedCell.description: A usage cell with its cost.

TrendCell.description: One cell of one trend bucket.

cell.description: The agent, prompt version, model and calls.

PricedTrendCell.description: A trend cell with its cost.

TopTrace.description: A trace with its total tokens and its calls per model.

total.description: Input, output and reasoning tokens of the trace's calls.

PricedTopTrace.description: A top trace with its cost.

user.description: The user of the session's first invocation; empty when none.

agent.description: The root agent of that invocation; empty when none.

first.description: The session's first activity in the range.

last.description: The session's last activity in the range.

errors.description: Model and tool errors, and rows with an error status.

ups.description: Latest boolean scores that are true.

downs.description: Latest boolean scores that are false.

tokens.description: The model response tokens per model.

trace_id.description: A trace id of the invocation's rows; null when none.

end.description: When the invocation completed; null when it has not.

tools.description: The tools it called, distinct, in first-call order.

tokens.description: Its model response tokens per model.

scores.description: The latest score per name and source.

user.description: The user id; empty for sessions without one.

ups.description: Latest boolean scores that are true.

downs.description: Latest boolean scores that are false.

last.description: The last activity of those sessions.

tokens.description: The model response tokens per model.

VersionStats.description: Calls, mean tokens and latency percentiles of one prompt version.

p50_ms.description: Median latency in milliseconds (approximate); null when no call has one.

p95_ms.description: 95th percentile latency in milliseconds (approximate); null when no call has one.

PricedVersionStats.description: A version's stats with the cost of its calls.

VersionModel.description: The calls of one prompt version on one model.

PricedVersionModel.description: A version's calls on one model with their cost.

FeedbackRow.description: The scores of one prompt version with one name, source and data type.

source.description: app or console (empty when the rows have none).

data_type.description: bool, number or category (empty when the rows have none).

count.description: How many scores (the latest per invocation, name and source).

mean.description: The mean of number scores; null for other data types.

mode.description: The most common category (ties: the lowest value); null for other data types.

source.description: app or console (empty when the row has none).

author.description: Who scored (empty when the row has none).

data_type.description: bool, number or category (empty when the row has none).

JudgeScore.description: The newest judge score of one name on a trace (a FEEDBACK row with source judge).

name.description: The score name: the monitor spec and the scorer kind joined by /, with _n appended for the n-th scorer of a kind (for example support-monitor/llm_judge_2).

pass.description: Whether the judge passed the run (its comment starts with pass:).

first.description: The trace's earliest model response in the range.

prompts.description: The trace's prompt versions as name@version, sorted.

thumbs_down.description: The distinct app thumbs-down scores on the trace.

judge.description: The newest judge score per name, sorted by name; empty when none. Judge scores never make a trace reviewed. This console always sends it; consoles before this release omit it.

cells.description: The cells, ordered by model, agent and prompt version, each priced.

truncated.description: The query hit its row cap: some cells are left out.

UsageTrend.description: The window start, the bucket width in seconds and the trend cells.

start.description: The window start; bucket counts buckets from here.

SessionTurns.description: A session's row and its turns.

turns.description: The session's first 200 turns, oldest first, each priced.

stats.description: One entry per version, newest first, each priced.

models.description: Calls and tokens per version and model, each priced.

truncated.description: A query hit its row cap: some versions or version-model rows are left out.

rows.description: One row per version, name, source and data type: newest version first, then by name, source and data type.
